_help: One line explaining each note type, shown on its page. Keys must match the 'type' in note_details.json.
Natural: Taken straight from a plant, flower, wood, resin or fruit - pressed, distilled or extracted.
Synthetic: Made in a lab. Some copy a smell found in nature, others create one nature never made.
Accord: Not one ingredient but a blend of several, built to suggest a smell - like a sketch of it.
Natural & synthetic: Comes both ways: there is a natural version and a lab-made one, and perfumers use either.
